Türkiye didn't change its clocks. Here's why 🇹🇷

▪️ Since 2016: UTC+3 all year. Türkiye stopped switching between summer and winter time.
▪️ In winter: Europe is 2 hours behind. London is 3 hours behind Istanbul, Berlin 2 hours.
▪️ Tip: Check meeting times. Calendar invites from abroad can show the wrong hour.

Turkish breakfast explained 🇹🇷

▪️ Kahvaltı: 'Before coffee'. That's literally what the word means.
▪️ On the table: Cheese, olives, menemen. Plus simit and endless çay.
▪️ Want it all?: Order 'serpme kahvaltı'. Dozens of small plates to share.
